decision.reason: The ideal full decode up/down fallback removal ceiling is above 10, but every current exact implementation family fails a hard gate: source/page-only is sub-10, exact full CUDA kernels exceed the entire margin, raw resident topN payloads do not fit, current CPU microkernel/source overlap remains sub-10 or too tight, exact graph/dataflow has no retained CUDA path, and non-native representations lack exactness/top1 proof.
reopen_conditions: A new exact graph/dataflow proof that reduces both source bytes and compute by construction and shows >10 tok/s with meaningful integration margin.
A new correctness-verified representation artifact that proves fixed-text top1 and an effective >5.33x payload/fallback reduction before runtime source changes.
A new external high-acceptance verifier/draft artifact with measured sublinear target verification and full RAM/VRAM/TTFT/correctness accounting.
Or explicit disk cleanup/relocation approval enabling full alternate GGUF correctness/performance tests.

purpose: Consolidate the remaining non-speculative exact decode up/down CPU fallback removal route after latest alternate/speculative/diskless refreshes.

route_table.reason: Source/page-only reaches about 9.221 tok/s and async/updown I/O requires far beyond measured bandwidth/dependency windows.

Raw/transposed exact kernels require about 2.0s for the full 148.916GiB call-weighted decode payload, exceeding the full fallback-removal margin before source/integration overhead; full resident payload is about 21.81GiB and does not fit.

Even perfect source/page overlap plus best CPU microprobe remains below 10 (about 9.810 tok/s); current hot path is about 46.9GiB/s and needs at least about 90.6GiB/s with zero overhead or 130+GiB/s with 500ms overhead.
route_table.route: source/page plus current/best CPU microkernel tuning

route_table.reason: Top3072 needs 12.75GiB and still misses 10 with zero overhead; top4096 first crosses 10 but needs 17.0GiB raw payload before gate/workspace, far above the ~3.2GiB extra pool that fits while preserving gate cache.
Exact DS4 gate/up/down math requires full selected expert-role payloads; row/column/subtensor slicing does not reduce bytes without changing math.
Whole MoE layer placement costs about 3264MiB per layer; at most four layers fit by destroying gate cache, and even extreme zero-overhead frontiers remain below 10.

Current DS4 graph has no retained gate output, current DS4_HOT recomputes/inflates payload, sparse retained top64 has only ~19ms theoretical margin and no dataflow proof, and exact kernels are too slow.

Exact compression is far below the required 5.33x; token-stable Q8_0 fitting payload is below 10; standalone MMVQ failed top1/gate-cache preservation; more aggressive representations lack fixed-text top1 proof.

async_source_cpu_batch_decision.next_step: Before runtime code, write and execute a hot CPU fallback lower-bound/microkernel feasibility audit: estimate the minimum possible hot fallback time from bytes, memory bandwidth, thread scheduling, and existing chunk traces. If it cannot save at least 1.53-2.53s, reject the joint path.
async_source_cpu_batch_decision.reason: The only mathematically positive 10 tok/s case requires near-perfect source overlap and at least about 50% hot compute reduction with almost no overhead. Existing exact same-op touch regressed badly, and no current evidence proves the required hot compute reduction.

next_allowed_work: Do not write a logit-changing exact graph/dataflow runtime patch from current evidence.
Reopen this class only after a new placement/kernel proof artifact satisfies the reopen conditions above.
Otherwise continue from the remaining classes in the plan: a new external high-acceptance verifier/draft artifact or a new correctness-verified representation artifact.
exact_graph_rejection.reason: The current exact graph/dataflow candidates all fail a hard gate: current DS4 graph has no retained gate output, current DS4_HOT recomputes gate and inflates payload, sparse retained top64 has only 18.947 ms theoretical margin and no dataflow proof, exact hot/full kernels are 3-5x too slow for the relevant bounds, and full payload/layer placement violates VRAM or gate-cache tradeoffs.

full_cuda_kernel_rejection.extra_gpu_layers: rejected: moving one full MoE layer to GPU costs about 3264 MiB and steals roughly 712 gate-cache slots, with an estimated gate penalty larger than the optimistic per-layer fallback saving; historical cpu_moe=39/38 runs already regressed.
full_cuda_kernel_rejection.full_exact_gpu_kernel: rejected: exact raw/transposed probes require about 2.0s kernel time for the full 148.916 GiB call-weighted decode payload, exceeding the 1.729s total margin before source or integration overhead.
full_cuda_kernel_rejection.full_mmvq_gpu_kernel: rejected before source edit: the measured non-exact MMVQ kernel leaves about 1.19s for source and integration, requiring at least about 18 GiB/s even with perfect per-run unique expert reuse or about 125 GiB/s without reuse; measured O_DIRECT is about 1.85 GiB/s and current page-source effective rate is about 9.17 GiB/s.
full_cuda_kernel_rejection.full_resident_payload: rejected: the decode unique up/down payload is about 21.81 GiB, larger than available VRAM and larger than the 16GB host/page-cache budget; preloading it at measured O_DIRECT speed would add about 11.8s TTFT.

next_allowed_work: Do not implement a new runtime representation path from the current evidence.
A future non-native route must begin with an offline or compare-only artifact that proves fixed-text top1 and the >5.33x/equivalent fallback reduction before source changes.
If no such representation appears, the remaining 10 tok/s route requires a new external high-acceptance verifier/draft artifact or a new exact graph/dataflow breakthrough with a hard bound above 10.
non_native_rejection.reason: Every current non-native route fails one of the hard gates: exact compression is far below the needed 5.33x reduction; Q8_0 exact arithmetic is token-stable but has a sub-10 fitting-payload ceiling; standalone MMVQ failed fixed-text top1 and gate-cache preservation; graph-level zero-transfer MMVQ lacks the retained CUDA dataflow and has only ~19 ms paper margin; more aggressive low-rank/sparsified/codebook representations have no top1 proof.

allowed_next: A top768 resident batched path may be planned only as an intermediate SOTA candidate with a separate cost/TTFT bound.

For the 10 tok/s goal, the next candidate must reduce payload footprint, avoid needing resident raw source for thousands of experts, or remove CPU fallback time through a different exact batching/microkernel path.
do_not_do: Do not implement a large source-resident top768 path as a claimed 10 tok/s route.
Do not rerun the slow per-call Q8_0 strict cold benchmark.
Do not sacrifice gate cache for a topN pool unless a new bound includes the resulting gate miss penalty and still exceeds the acceptance gate.
q80_source_resident_decision.reason: The smallest near-10 payload is at least 12.75 GiB with no overhead slack, and the first positive 10 tok/s bound needs 17.0 GiB. Current extra usable VRAM with gate cache preserved is about 3.2 GiB.
